location_fine: prison corridors and prison yard gate
visual_synopsis: Establishing shots of a prison with a manned watchtower and barbed wire lead into interior corridors and stairwells where uniformed guards escort a group of men in dark coats, and a guard in a camo cap roughly handles one of them at a control hatch. The rest of the sketch plays outdoors by a blue metal door in the prison yard, where a man in a purple-and-blue tracksuit jacket and a man in an olive jacket carrying a white cloth parcel stand smoking and talking, then shake hands and part.
